criteria.observations: Resolve takes injected absolute cwd/home and selector, returns scope and origins, and performs no writes, prompts, process-directory changes or output. The prospective configuration seam is also read-only.

Nearest physical depth wins across storage locations, project wins at equal depth, explicit kinds filter candidates, conflicts preserve origins, malformed candidates fail, and irrelevant broader files are not read.

Canonical physical ancestry and same-file comparison handle symlinks and alternate casing. Original selected paths are validated, with authored and resolved values in failures. Selected broken mappings never fall back.
Aliases select concrete entries without checkout/cwd availability or cwd configuration. Unrelated record/root target failures remain lazy.

Real temporary filesystem tests cover nested scope, filtering, root conflicts, symlinks, home/Git/root traversal, malformed and unreadable files, reserved personal configuration, and marker-plus-mapping permissions. Independently authored conformance tests cover workspace comparisons.

observations: Reviewed resolve.go, compare.go, path changes, and both test slices against the selected ticket and specification.

An unreadable registration prefix could conceal a symlink into start. The original prefix heuristic was replaced by an explicit unresolved-binding diagnostic. The permission regression executed and passed.
Prospective configuration validation preserves symlink parent semantics without creating the future .context directory.
